sgs_coverage.note: Escape, outside-click and the scroll lock are all shipped but UNCONDITIONAL: store.js binds an Escape handler, and the lock uses the fixed-position technique (not a simple overflow toggle) precisely because iOS Safari ignores overflow:hidden. modality=modal|non-modal is the only operator lever, and it governs inertness, not the dismissal set. So the 6 references that lock scroll and the 5 that close on Escape are covered, while 'Escape does not close' (7 references) and 'scroll is not locked' (8 references) have no expression — and neither should be added, because both are a11y regressions (WCAG 1.4.13 Dismissible). Three routes have no equivalent at all and are NOT a11y defects: close-on-scroll (lamalama), a keyboard hotkey (wearecollins 'm'), and history-back as a closer (resn's hash routes).
sgs_coverage.how_checked: src/shared/nav-interactivity/store.js (the `'Escape' === e.key && drawer.open` handler; freezeBackground/unfreezeBackground; the documentElement.style.overflowY fixed-position lock with its 'iOS Safari ignores overflow:hidden on body' comment); src/blocks/nav-drawer/block.json::attributes.modality
